title: Topic 19
japanese_text:
A：Ｃくんにお金、返したの？
B：あー、もうちょっと生活が上向いたら返すつもり…。
A：この辺の<u>値打ち</u>がありそうな本、売ってお金にすれば？早く返した方がいいよ。
english_translation: A: Did you pay back the money to C? B: Oh, I'm going to pay him back once life starts looking up... A: Why don't you sell all these books and make some money? I'm sure they're worth something. You'd better pay it back soon.
